description: JetFuelBurn is a Python package for estimating fuel burn on commercial-aircraft flights. Its repository identifies the package, PyPI distribution and documentation, while the JOSS paper describes methods for flight-level estimates. A user selects aircraft and route or flight assumptions, so geographic coverage is the chosen route and temporal coverage is the simulated flight; the package does not publish airline operating data. The own repository and PyPI metadata state MIT. Fuel estimates can support aviation-demand scenarios, airport emissions analysis or comparison of fleet choices in a transport simulation. A caveat is that fuel use depends on payload, weather, routing, aircraft condition and operational choices. A calculated flight is not a verified airline fuel record, and it does not represent airport ground operations. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. The JOSS article and own repository were inspected without calculating a flight. No directly related catalogue record was established.
